_about: Top-level paths that check_render's navigation coverage does not require the header menu or the footer to link, each with the reason. Anything else with records that neither links fails the check. Admin pages and /graph are guarded and never checked. Add a path here only with a reason a reader would accept.
search: reached by the search box in the header on every page
send: reached from the record it is for: the link under an empty portrait on a war memorial or person record (/send?for=<id>)
